title: One afternoon of supply-chain hardening.
description: On 22 November we pinned actions to SHAs and added Dependabot cooldowns, pnpm trust settings, security policies and dist checks across four repos.
lede: On 22 November, between about 12:30 and 13:40 UTC, the same set of controls went into four repos. This is what they are, what each one stops, and where a repo still lacks one.
summary: Pinned actions, Dependabot cooldowns, pnpm release-age and trust settings, SECURITY.md and dist checks, added across four repos on 22 November. With the gaps we still have.
